text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected 1718001234 — autoscaler failing to provision GPUs in asia-southeast2. Symptom: queue growth + GCP quota denies. Impact: elevated latency for APAC customers, some 503s. Triggered at 2026-03-15T03:20:34Z.

oncall-anna: Ack. I'm on it. Paging SRE.

sre-josh: looking. seeing repeated 403 QUOTA_EXCEEDED from GCP on create-instance. Queue length for gpu-workers rose from ~2k -> ~18k in ~8 minutes.

infra-maya: confirms: quota call returns 'RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_T4' exceeded'. No spare project quota and provisioning requests are blocked at the cloud layer.

eng-runtime-raj: copying relevant logs:
```
provisioner: allocate workers -> failed: quotaExceeded
http 403 createInstance: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_T4' exceeded for project 12345
```

prod-support-lee: customer-facing signals inbound — support sees increased timeouts. Which customers are hit hardest?

customer-success-sam: pulling list now, will prepare outreach for top impacted accounts.

sre-josh: immediate mitigations I'm initiating:
- enable cross-region spill: route asia-southeast2 -> us-central1 for non-low-latency workloads
- enable CPU fallback for embed-only/low-precision jobs
- throttle non-enterprise traffic by ~60% to prioritize reserved capacity
Executing rule 'apac-spill-2026-03-15' now.

deploy-bot: Route policy 'apac-spill-2026-03-15' activated (ID: rp-8342). Rolling out in ~30s.

oncall-anna: Good. Also open a GCP quota case and loop in TAM. @infra-maya can you escalate?

infra-maya: opened support case GCP-987654321, marked P1. Contacted TAM on Slack and email; ETA for quota adjustment 4-6 hours according to initial response.

sre-josh: spill is reducing the backlog; backlog down to ~5.2k. CPU fallback handling ~18% of traffic. Tail latency still elevated for some routes.

customer-success-sam: drafting status: "We're experiencing constrained GPU capacity in APAC causing higher latency and some request failures. Traffic is being rerouted and mitigations are active. We're working with our cloud provider for a quota increase." Will post when approved.

prod-support-lee: sending targeted notices to the top 10 impacted customers and those with SLA exposure.

eng-runtime-raj: adding temporary autoscaler preference to prefer regions with spare quota and reducing batch sizes where safe to lower GPU pressure.

sre-josh: applied policy 'prefer-spare-capacity' — will prefer us-central1 and eu-west1 when available. Monitoring for new hotspots after spill.

oncall-anna: Handoff in 20 minutes to night oncall. @sre-miguel please be ready to take over, and have contact list for Sales/CS in case of credit requests.

sre-miguel: ack — I'll take next shift. Please DM any adhoc notes.

prod-support-lee: assembling list of impacted accounts + estimated SLA exposure and attaching to incident ticket. ETA 10m.

customer-success-sam: posted status update to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded performance in APAC; mitigations active. We're routing traffic to alternate regions and working with the provider on quota increase." https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2026-03-15-apac-gpu

sre-josh: metrics: queue stable ~4.8k and trending down. If queue drops under 500 we can consider disabling spill. Keep alerts on for us-central1 saturation.

deploy-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-APAC-GPU-2026 acknowledged by oncall-anna.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=partial, incident_id=INC-APAC-GPU-2026

oncall-anna: Prep notes for handoff (short):
- root cause: project-scoped GPU quota exhausted in asia-southeast2; autoscaler requests failing with quota errors.
- mitigations: cross-region routing, CPU fallback, non-critical traffic throttle, lowered batch sizes, preference policy to avoid saturated regions.
- outstanding: GCP case GCP-987654321 (quota increase); monitor spill latency; prepare to route to additional regions if us-central1 hits limits.

sre-josh: quick commands I ran:
```
gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast2 --project=redwood-prod
gcloud compute instances list --filter="acceleratorType:NVIDIA_TESLA_T4" --project=redwood-prod
```

oncall-anna: Handoff complete. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft tomorrow morning. Thanks for the fast triage. :coffee:

sre-miguel: taking ownership of monitor and customer comms for the night. Will escalate to Sales if customers request credits.

prod-support-lee: attaching account list to ticket now.

incident-bot: Note: maintain channel for updates. Close when all mitigations reverted and queue normal.
